title: Converbs I: when, by, without
summary: Link actions in time and manner with five converbs: `-(y)IncA` **when, once** (*Eve gelince ararım*) and `-(y)IncAyA kadar` **until**, `-(y)ArAk` **by, while** (*Koşarak geldi*), `-mAdAn` **without** and **before**, `-DIktAn sonra` **after**, and `-(y)AlI` **since** (*Buraya geleli üç yıl oldu*).
canDo: Say what you do when, before and after something happens
Say how you do something: on foot, with a laugh, by working hard
Say what you did without doing something else
Say how long it has been since something happened
